capture_targets.minimum: At least 34 verified rows per SCI-PAN-01 section 8.1: method facts (1 each), 6 Tithi endings, 6 Nakshatra endings, 6 Yoga endings, 4 named Karana transitions including Kimstughna and a fixed Karana, Yoga and Karana name lists (1 each), 4 Central Station sunrise/sunset rows at solstices and equinoxes; spread over at least three seasons
method_facts_to_record_verbatim: Ayanamsa used and its stated value or epoch
Whether ending moments are geocentric and in IST
Sunrise/sunset definition (upper limb or centre; refraction included or not) and the station(s) it applies to
Rounding of printed times (truncated or rounded minute)
Karana names and their order as printed
Any statement on Vara (civil date or sunrise)
Central Station coordinates and the refraction and semidiameter values used

source.publisher: Positional Astronomy Centre, India Meteorological Department
source.rights_note: Record the publication's reuse statement verbatim; copy only the individual facts needed, never pages

row_template.station_or_location: geocentric | station name with latitude/longitude as printed

row_template.status: UNVERIFIED until a second person checks the row against the source

notation_rules.24_hour_plus: A printed time of hh:mm with hh >= 24 on civil date D means (hh-24):mm IST on civil date D+1. Store printed_value and printed_date unchanged, and add derived_instant_utc as a DERIVED field.
notation_rules.central_station: Sunrise and sunset values apply to the IMD Central Station (82 deg 30 min E, 23 deg 11 min N, as reported). Never compare them with city coordinates.
notation_rules.geocentric_endings: Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga and Karana ending times are geocentric moments in IST (as reported) and need no city correction.

Not fixtures, not expected values, not counted in any reference total. Each must be confirmed against the primary page by a person with access, then moved into rows with full provenance.
method_facts: Sunrise/sunset: upper solar limb with refraction; refraction 31 arcmin + semidiameter 16 arcmin, so the geometric centre is 47 arcmin below the horizon (source cited: /panchang/en/explanation)
Station-based sunrise/sunset belong to the Central Station 82 deg 30 min E, 23 deg 11 min N; geocentric ending times are in IST

values.independent_consistency: Consistent with USNO and NASA Full Moon 2026-10-26 04:12 UT = 09:42 IST (PAN-REF-PHASE-2026-41)
